name: agent
title: Agent transport
description: Reads Gmail or Slack by having your Claude Code session fetch it with the connectors you already authorised there.

mailbox.label: Label or channel
mailbox.hint: Gmail: a label (defaults to INBOX). Slack: a channel ID (C…), required.

harness.label: Worker CLI
harness.hint: The agent CLI that does the reading. Defaults to claude.

send_agent.label: Send agent
send_agent.hint: The persona that writes a reply. Empty means the connector's own (`emailer` for gmail, `slack-poster` for slack).

send_subagent.label: Send subagent
send_subagent.hint: Empty means the connector's own (`email_sender` for gmail, `slack_sender` for slack).

deadline_seconds.label: Fetch deadline (seconds)
deadline_seconds.hint: Wall-clock for one fetch; a worker past it is killed so it cannot hold the source's slot forever.

send_deadline_seconds.label: Send deadline (seconds)
send_deadline_seconds.hint: Wall-clock for one send — shorter than a fetch: a fetch may sweep a mailbox, a send writes one message.
